content.text:
SYNTAX OK
    pidfile="/run/qisutu/$base.pid"
    if [ -f "$pidfile" ]; then
        pid="$(cat "$pidfile" 2>/dev/null)"
        if [ -n "$pid" ]; then
            kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
            for _ in $(seq 1 15); do
                kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break
                sleep 1
            done
            kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null && kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
        rm -f "$pidfile"
    fi
    return 0
}
path_active() { grep -qF " path-$1=active" "$STATE" 2>/dev/null; }
path_activate() { state_set "path-$1" active; }
path_deactivate() { state_set "path-$1" inactive; }
